definitions.gloss: to refuse; to reject; to deny
definitions.explanation: To firmly and categorically refuse a request, demand, or proposal. Stronger and more definitive than simply declining.

examples.japanese: ⟦{要求|ようきゅう}→要求：03658_youkyuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{拒絶|きょぜつ}した。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{面会|めんかい}→面会：15925_menkai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{拒絶|きょぜつ}した。
examples.english: She refused to meet with them.

examples.japanese: ⟦{移植|いしょく}→移植：13761_ishoku⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{臓器|ぞうき}→臓器：05705_zouki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{拒絶|きょぜつ}する⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are cases where the body rejects a transplanted organ.

notes:
A strong word for refusal that implies a firm, absolute rejection. Composed of {拒|きょ} (resist, refuse) + {絶|ぜつ} (sever, cut off). The double emphasis on cutting off makes this stronger than ⟦{断|ことわ}る→断る：02102_kotowaru⟧ or ⟦{拒否|きょひ}する→拒否する：21331_kyohisuru⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{拒絶|きょぜつ}{反応|はんのう}→拒絶反応：15185_kyozetsuhannou⟧ — rejection reaction (medical, as in organ transplants)
- ⟦{要求|ようきゅう}→要求：03658_youkyuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{拒絶|きょぜつ}する — to reject a demand
- ⟦{入国|にゅうこく}→入国：15859_nyuukoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{拒絶|きょぜつ}する — to refuse entry (to a country)
- ⟦{拒絶|きょぜつ}→拒絶：12788_kyozetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意思|いし}→意思：12742_ishi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{示|しめ}す→示す：01948_shimesu⟧ — to indicate refusal

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{拒否|きょひ}する→拒否する：21331_kyohisuru⟧ — to refuse, to deny; slightly less forceful, more common in everyday use
- ⟦{断|ことわ}る→断る：02102_kotowaru⟧ — to refuse, to decline; general-purpose, can be polite
- ⟦{却下|きゃっか}→却下：05908_kyakka⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to reject (an application, proposal); official/administrative

REGISTER:
Formal and somewhat literary. More common in writing, news, and legal/medical contexts than in everyday conversation.
